# CASE 17

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# TRAIN

```{r }
library(tidyverse)

# TRAIN DATA

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

slow_threshold <- quantile(long_data$time, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    long_pause_count = sum(time > slow_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_)
  )

# FIT NORMAL DEPENDENCIES

m_price_items <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
m_time_items  <- lm(avg_time_per_item ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
m_depts_items <- lm(unique_departments ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
m_share_price <- lm(max_price_share ~ total_price, data = basket_data)
m_ipd_depts   <- lm(items_per_department ~ unique_departments, data = basket_data)
m_pps_time    <- lm(price_per_second ~ total_time, data = basket_data)

# robust residual scaling helper
mad_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- mad(x, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ifelse(is.na(v) || v <= 0, sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), v)
}

# TRAIN SCORES

basket_dependency <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    pred_total_price = predict(m_price_items, newdata = .),
    pred_avg_time_per_item = predict(m_time_items, newdata = .),
    pred_unique_departments = predict(m_depts_items, newdata = .),
    pred_max_price_share = predict(m_share_price, newdata = .),
    pred_items_per_department = predict(m_ipd_depts, newdata = .),
    pred_price_per_second = predict(m_pps_time, newdata = .)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resid_total_price = total_price - pred_total_price,
    resid_avg_time_per_item = avg_time_per_item - pred_avg_time_per_item,
    resid_unique_departments = unique_departments - pred_unique_departments,
    resid_max_price_share = max_price_share - pred_max_price_share,
    resid_items_per_department = items_per_department - pred_items_per_department,
    resid_price_per_second = price_per_second - pred_price_per_second
  )

scale_total_price <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_total_price)
scale_avg_time <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_avg_time_per_item)
scale_unique_depts <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_unique_departments)
scale_max_share <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_max_price_share)
scale_ipd <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_items_per_department)
scale_pps <- mad_safe(basket_dependency$resid_price_per_second)

basket_dependency <- basket_dependency %>%
  mutate(
    z_total_price = abs(resid_total_price) / scale_total_price,
    z_avg_time_per_item = abs(resid_avg_time_per_item) / scale_avg_time,
    z_unique_departments = abs(resid_unique_departments) / scale_unique_depts,
    z_max_price_share = abs(resid_max_price_share) / scale_max_share,
    z_items_per_department = abs(resid_items_per_department) / scale_ipd,
    z_price_per_second = abs(resid_price_per_second) / scale_pps,
    dependency_violation_score =
      z_total_price +
      z_avg_time_per_item +
      z_unique_departments +
      z_max_price_share +
      z_items_per_department +
      z_price_per_second
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(dependency_violation_score))

top_150_dependency_train <- basket_dependency %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_dependency_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_dependency_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_dependency_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_dependency_train$dependency_violation_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_dependency_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_dependency_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r }
# CASE17: PURE DEPENDENCY VIOLATION SCORE

case17_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case17.csv", warn = FALSE)

case17_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case17_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case17_long <- case17_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

slow_threshold_case17 <- quantile(case17_long$time, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

case17_basket <- case17_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    long_pause_count = sum(time > slow_threshold_case17, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case17_dept_share <- case17_long %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case17_basket <- case17_basket %>%
  left_join(case17_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_)
  )

# APPLY TRAINED DEPENDENCY MODELS

case17_dependency <- case17_basket %>%
  mutate(
    pred_total_price = predict(m_price_items, newdata = .),
    pred_avg_time_per_item = predict(m_time_items, newdata = .),
    pred_unique_departments = predict(m_depts_items, newdata = .),
    pred_max_price_share = predict(m_share_price, newdata = .),
    pred_items_per_department = predict(m_ipd_depts, newdata = .),
    pred_price_per_second = predict(m_pps_time, newdata = .)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resid_total_price = total_price - pred_total_price,
    resid_avg_time_per_item = avg_time_per_item - pred_avg_time_per_item,
    resid_unique_departments = unique_departments - pred_unique_departments,
    resid_max_price_share = max_price_share - pred_max_price_share,
    resid_items_per_department = items_per_department - pred_items_per_department,
    resid_price_per_second = price_per_second - pred_price_per_second
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    z_total_price = abs(resid_total_price) / scale_total_price,
    z_avg_time_per_item = abs(resid_avg_time_per_item) / scale_avg_time,
    z_unique_departments = abs(resid_unique_departments) / scale_unique_depts,
    z_max_price_share = abs(resid_max_price_share) / scale_max_share,
    z_items_per_department = abs(resid_items_per_department) / scale_ipd,
    z_price_per_second = abs(resid_price_per_second) / scale_pps,
    dependency_violation_score =
      z_total_price +
      z_avg_time_per_item +
      z_unique_departments +
      z_max_price_share +
      z_items_per_department +
      z_price_per_second
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(dependency_violation_score))

top_150_dependency_case17 <- case17_dependency %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_dependency_case17$total_items)
summary(top_150_dependency_case17$total_price)
summary(top_150_dependency_case17$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_dependency_case17$dependency_violation_score)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_dependency_case17$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_dependency_case17,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_dependency_case17.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
